# GitHub Repository Settings

## Repository Description (About section)
Copy this into your GitHub repository's "About" section:

```
🖥️ Cross-platform Task Manager for Windows & macOS — Built with .NET 8 and Avalonia UI
```

## Topics (Tags)
Add these topics to your repository for discoverability:

```
dotnet
csharp
avalonia
task-manager
cross-platform
system-monitor
process-manager
mvvm
desktop-app
macos
windows
```

## Social Preview
Consider creating a social preview image (1280x640px) showing:
- The app's main window with the dark theme
- The TaskMGR logo
- Platform badges (Windows + macOS)

## Website
If you deploy a landing page, add it here. Otherwise, leave blank.
